A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work, with VAE-REPA renamed SRA 2. All 11 pages of each PDF are readable and support comparison. Both end with references; neither contains the appendix mentioned in the text, so no appendix content was available to compare.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original ImageNet generation experiments, ablations, computational measurements, and MS-COCO text-to-image results in Tables 1–5.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains these original empirical results under the renamed method SRA 2.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same pretrained SD-VAE features, intermediate SiT feature projection, smooth-L1 alignment objective, and combined training loss. Renaming VAE-REPA to SRA 2 does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ImageNet 256×256 image generation and MS-COCO text-to-image generation. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2–5, including the REPA and VAVAE comparisons and the MMDiT baseline, REPA, and SRA text-to-image comparison. SRA remains a baseline; SRA 2 is the renamed proposed method.

E3.justification: The same model scales, preprocessing, training budgets, metrics, 50K evaluation samples, and 250-step sampling procedure are reported. The text-to-image experiment retains 150K training iterations, batch size 256, and guidance scale 2.0.

E4.justification: Table 1 retains the same ablations of alignment depth, timestep range, objective, loss weight, and MLP depth. The feature visualizations and qualitative training comparisons in Figures 2 and 4 also retain the same analyses and examples.

E5.justification: Figure 4 retains the same statement about matching sampling seeds, noise, and class labels. Neither version reports repeated-run aggregates, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All corresponding numerical entries in Tables 1–5 are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains FID 8.2 at 1M iterations, and Table 4 retains FID 4.67 and PickScore 20.92 for the proposed method. The displayed qualitative examples are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8 and their mathematical definitions remain unchanged, including the interpolation, velocity and score relations, alignment loss, and total objective. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of accelerating diffusion training through existing VAE features without extra guidance models and with approximately 4% additional GFLOPs. The self-representation terminology does not substantively alter these contributions.

C2.justification: The explanations of VAE visual priors, degradation from deeper-layer alignment, complementary guidance across noise levels, and benefits of a deeper MLP are retained. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: The supplied implementation information remains unchanged, including optimizer settings, feature dimensions, alignment hyperparameters, sampling details, and H100 hardware disclosure. No code or data access information is added. Both versions refer to additional implementation details in an appendix absent from the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: The reference list and substantive comparisons with external encoders, dual-model alignment, and VAE-based acceleration remain unchanged. The SRA 2 name does not accompany a revised explanation of novelty or relationship to prior work.

P1.justification: v2.pdf renames the method throughout, adds Self-Representation to the title, and revises the introductory naming sentence. It also adds corresponding-author markers and a funding acknowledgment. The section order and substantive narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 4's method labels and relevant captions and table rows are updated to SRA 2 while preserving the examples and table structures. The author footnote, acknowledgment, and naming edits cause limited layout reflow; no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: The revision primarily changes naming and adds author-role and funding information. The method, empirical evidence, mathematical treatment, and reproducibility information remain unchanged. These limited editorial updates do not materially improve or worsen the paper's overall clarity or evidential support.
